# Agent rules

Read [OWNER-DIRECTIVES.md](OWNER-DIRECTIVES.md) first. It overrides conflicting
roadmap and tooling text. Follow the active `work/WO-*.md`; inspect its allowed
and protected paths before editing. Keep each work order buildable, tested,
verified, and recorded in `STATE.md` and the ledgers.

## Platform and product locks

- Initial support is Apple Silicon macOS 13+. Do not add Linux/Windows code,
  shims, CI jobs, runners, packaging, or portability work.
- Keep platform implementations behind `platform/` interfaces; do not add
  stubs for unsupported operating systems.
- Rust for all first-party code is the active owner-approved migration target.
  MPL-2.0, minimal pinned dependencies, custom-drawn UI, and an owned SVG
  parser/rasterizer remain locked. Legacy C17 code is preserved as migration
  reference; do not resume old C implementation orders. See ADR-0022.
- Never read, fetch, or copy GPL SVG-editor source. Do not fetch external SVG
  resources from the application. Record provenance for external algorithms.

## Repository map

- `app/`: executable composition.
- `src/`: base, platform, XML/SVG, scene, raster, document, UI modules as added.
- `docs/research-r4/`: authoritative operating model and roadmap.
- `docs/research-r3/plan/`: architecture and coding guidance where r4 is silent.
- `docs/adr/`: accepted decisions; `work/`: immutable ready work orders.
- `tests/`: unit, property, fuzz, UI, and oracle tests as introduced.
- `bench/`: corpus metadata, generators, runners, and results.
- `artifacts/`: work-order evidence; `build/` and `.cache/` are generated.

## Commands

The commands below are the preserved legacy C workflow. Rust workspace/build
commands become authoritative only through their implementation orders.

- `./dev build`: configure and build Debug.
- `./dev test-fast`: run local Python tests and validate the ledger.
- `./dev verify`: run the Debug build and fast tests.
- `cmake --preset mac-release && cmake --build --preset mac-release`: Release.
- `python3 scripts/ledger.py validate ledger.jsonl`: validate work history.
- `python3 -m unittest`: run Python harness tests when present.
- `bench`, `fmt`, `lint`, `asan`, and `fuzz` become authoritative only when
  their work orders implement them; do not claim missing commands run.

## Engineering and safety

Use the contracts in `docs/CODING_STANDARD.md`: explicit ownership, pointer+length
slices, checked size arithmetic, bounded user input, no VLAs, and no unsafe
string functions. Preserve unknown SVG/XML source. Keep generated files in
ignored repo-local directories. Do not install system packages or touch sibling
directories. Add dependencies only through an ADR and pinned provenance record.

Never weaken frozen acceptance tests or oracles. Run commands named by the
active work order, then report exact evidence. Do not invent test or performance
results. Keep source files focused and under 800 lines; split cohesive modules
before they grow further.

## Rust migration execution

Follow `docs/product/rust-port-goal-and-plan.md` and ready Rust work orders.
Multiple Luna codex exec processes are authorized, with isolated current-source
worktrees and disjoint modules; coordinator alone changes shared manifests,
locks, interfaces and ledgers. Use Low for inventory/docs, Medium for routine
ports, High for parser/renderer/concurrency/unsafe FFI. Escalate only on a named
problem; use the existing subscription allowance and no purchased credits.
Preserve strict validation, original fixtures/assertions and byte-preserving
round trips. Rust ownership replaces manual C ownership conventions; bounded
inputs, checked arithmetic, safe cleanup and source limits still apply. Keep
unsafe operations behind documented platform/FFI boundaries.

## Platform and product locks

- Initial support is Apple Silicon macOS 13+. Do not add Linux/Windows code,
  shims, CI jobs, runners, packaging, or portability work.
- Keep platform implementations behind `platform/` interfaces; do not add
  stubs for unsupported operating systems.
- Rust for all first-party code is the active owner-approved migration target.
  MPL-2.0, minimal pinned dependencies, custom-drawn UI, and an owned SVG
  parser/rasterizer remain locked. Legacy C17 code is preserved as migration
  reference; do not resume old C implementation orders. See ADR-0022.
- Never read, fetch, or copy GPL SVG-editor source. Do not fetch external SVG
  resources from the application. Record provenance for external algorithms.

## Repository map

- `app/`: executable composition.
- `src/`: base, platform, XML/SVG, scene, raster, document, UI modules as added.
- `docs/research-r4/`: authoritative operating model and roadmap.
- `docs/research-r3/plan/`: architecture and coding guidance where r4 is silent.
- `docs/adr/`: accepted decisions; `work/`: immutable ready work orders.
- `tests/`: unit, property, fuzz, UI, and oracle tests as introduced.
- `bench/`: corpus metadata, generators, runners, and results.
- `artifacts/`: work-order evidence; `build/` and `.cache/` are generated.

The commands below are the preserved legacy C workflow. Rust workspace/build
commands become authoritative only through their implementation orders.

- `./dev build`: configure and build Debug.
- `./dev test-fast`: run local Python tests and validate the ledger.
- `./dev verify`: run the Debug build and fast tests.
- `cmake --preset mac-release && cmake --build --preset mac-release`: Release.

Use the contracts in `docs/CODING_STANDARD.md`: explicit ownership, pointer+length
slices, checked size arithmetic, bounded user input, no VLAs, and no unsafe
string functions. Preserve unknown SVG/XML source. Keep generated files in
ignored repo-local directories. Do not install system packages or touch sibling
directories. Add dependencies only through an ADR and pinned provenance record.

Never weaken frozen acceptance tests or oracles. Run commands named by the
active work order, then report exact evidence. Do not invent test or performance
results. Keep source files focused and under 800 lines; split cohesive modules
before they grow further.

static uint8_t ui_glyph_row(uint8_t character, size_t row)
{
    if (character >= 'a' && character <= 'z') character = (uint8_t)(character - 'a' + 'A');
    if (character >= '0' && character <= '9') return ui_font[character - '0'][row];
    if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') return ui_font[10U + character - 'A'][row];
    switch (character) {
        case ' ': return 0U;
        case '-': return row == 3U ? 14U : 0U;
        case '_': return row == 6U ? 31U : 0U;
        case '.': return row == 6U ? 4U : 0U;
        case ',': return row == 6U ? 4U : row == 5U ? 8U : 0U;
        case ':': return row == 2U || row == 5U ? 4U : 0U;
        case ';': return row == 2U ? 4U : row == 5U ? 4U : row == 6U ? 8U : 0U;
        case '/': return (uint8_t)(1U << (row > 4U ? 0U : 4U - row));
        case '\\': return (uint8_t)(1U << (row < 5U ? row : 4U));
        case '#': return row == 2U || row == 4U ? 31U : row == 1U || row == 5U ? 10U : 0U;
        case '%': return row == 0U || row == 6U ? 17U : row == 1U || row == 5U ? 2U : row == 2U || row == 4U ? 4U : 8U;
        case '=': return row == 2U || row == 4U ? 14U : 0U;
        case '+': return row == 3U ? 14U : row == 1U || row == 2U || row == 4U || row == 5U ? 4U : 0U;
        case '[': return row == 0U || row == 6U ? 14U : 8U;
        case ']': return row == 0U || row == 6U ? 14U : 2U;
        case '<': return row == 3U ? 2U : row == 2U || row == 4U ? 4U : row == 1U || row == 5U ? 8U : 0U;
        case '>': return row == 3U ? 8U : row == 2U || row == 4U ? 4U : row == 1U || row == 5U ? 2U : 0U;
        case '(': return row == 0U || row == 6U ? 2U : row == 1U || row == 5U ? 4U : 8U;
        case ')': return row == 0U || row == 6U ? 8U : row == 1U || row == 5U ? 4U : 2U;
        case '!': return row < 5U ? 4U : row == 6U ? 4U : 0U;
        case '?': return row == 0U ? 14U : row == 1U ? 17U : row == 2U ? 2U : row == 3U ? 4U : row == 6U ? 4U : 0U;
        case '\'': return row < 2U ? 4U : 0U;
        case '"': return row < 2U ? 10U : 0U;
        case '*': return row == 1U || row == 5U ? 10U : row == 2U || row == 4U ? 4U : row == 3U ? 14U : 0U;
        case '|': return 4U;
        case '&': return row == 0U ? 12U : row == 1U || row == 2U ? 18U : row == 3U ? 12U : row == 4U || row == 5U ? 21U : 10U;
        default: return row == 0U || row == 6U ? 14U : row == 1U || row == 5U ? 17U : row == 2U || row == 4U ? 2U : 4U;
    }
}

static bool ui_pixel_valid(const ui_node *node, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                           uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
{
    return x >= node->bounds.x && y >= node->bounds.y &&
        x - node->bounds.x < node->bounds.width &&
        y - node->bounds.y < node->bounds.height && x < width && y < height;
}

static void ui_blend_pixel(uint8_t *destination, uint32_t color)
{
    uint32_t alpha = color & 255U;
    uint32_t inverse = 255U - alpha;
    uint32_t destination_alpha = destination[3];
    uint32_t out_alpha = alpha + (destination_alpha * inverse + 127U) / 255U;
    if (out_alpha == 0U) return;
    for (size_t channel = 0U; channel < 3U; ++channel) {
        uint32_t source = (color >> (24U - (uint32_t)(channel * 8U))) & 255U;
        uint32_t numerator = source * alpha * 255U +
            (uint32_t)destination[channel] * destination_alpha * inverse;
        destination[channel] = (uint8_t)((numerator + out_alpha * 127U) / (out_alpha * 255U));
    }
    destination[3] = (uint8_t)out_alpha;
}

static void ui_paint_rect(const ui_node *node, uint32_t color, uint8_t *rgba,
                          size_t stride, uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
{
    uint32_t x_end = node->bounds.x + node->bounds.width;
    uint32_t y_end = node->bounds.y + node->bounds.height;
    if (x_end < node->bounds.x || x_end > width) x_end = width;
    if (y_end < node->bounds.y || y_end > height) y_end = height;
    for (uint32_t y = node->bounds.y; y < y_end; ++y)
        for (uint32_t x = node->bounds.x; x < x_end; ++x)
            ui_blend_pixel(rgba + (size_t)y * stride + (size_t)x * 4U, color);
}

static bool ui_inside_rounded_corner(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t width,
                                     uint32_t height, uint32_t radius)
{
    if (radius == 0U) return true;
    uint32_t dx = x < radius ? radius - x :
        (x >= width - radius ? x - (width - radius - 1U) : 0U);
    uint32_t dy = y < radius ? radius - y :
        (y >= height - radius ? y - (height - radius - 1U) : 0U);
    if (dx == 0U || dy == 0U) return true;
    uint64_t edge = (uint64_t)radius * radius;
    uint64_t distance = (uint64_t)dx * dx + (uint64_t)dy * dy;
    return distance <= edge;
}

static void ui_paint_rounded_rect(const ui_node *node, uint32_t color,
                                  uint32_t radius, uint8_t *rgba,
                                  size_t stride, uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
{
    if (node->bounds.x >= width || node->bounds.y >= height) return;
    uint32_t right = node->bounds.x + node->bounds.width;
    uint32_t bottom = node->bounds.y + node->bounds.height;
    if (right < node->bounds.x || right > width) right = width;
    if (bottom < node->bounds.y || bottom > height) bottom = height;
    uint32_t local_width = right - node->bounds.x;
    uint32_t local_height = bottom - node->bounds.y;
    if (radius > local_width / 2U) radius = local_width / 2U;
    if (radius > local_height / 2U) radius = local_height / 2U;
    for (uint32_t y = node->bounds.y; y < bottom; ++y) {
        for (uint32_t x = node->bounds.x; x < right; ++x) {
            if (!ui_inside_rounded_corner(x - node->bounds.x, y - node->bounds.y,
                    local_width, local_height, radius)) continue;
            ui_blend_pixel(rgba + (size_t)y * stride + (size_t)x * 4U, color);
        }
    }
}

static void ui_paint_control_outline(const ui_node *node, uint32_t color,
                                     uint32_t radius, uint8_t *rgba,
                                     size_t stride, uint32_t width,
                                     uint32_t height)
{
    uint32_t right = node->bounds.x + node->bounds.width;
    uint32_t bottom = node->bounds.y + node->bounds.height;
    if (right < node->bounds.x || right > width) right = width;
    if (bottom < node->bounds.y || bottom > height) bottom = height;
    uint32_t local_width = right - node->bounds.x;
    uint32_t local_height = bottom - node->bounds.y;
    if (local_width == 0U || local_height == 0U) return;
    if (radius > local_width / 2U) radius = local_width / 2U;
    if (radius > local_height / 2U) radius = local_height / 2U;
    for (uint32_t y = node->bounds.y; y < bottom; ++y) {
        for (uint32_t x = node->bounds.x; x < right; ++x) {
            bool edge = x == node->bounds.x || x + 1U == right ||
                y == node->bounds.y || y + 1U == bottom;
            if (!edge || !ui_inside_rounded_corner(x - node->bounds.x,
                    y - node->bounds.y, local_width, local_height, radius)) continue;
            ui_blend_pixel(rgba + (size_t)y * stride + (size_t)x * 4U, color);
        }
    }
}

static void ui_paint_text(const char *text, size_t length, uint32_t color,
                          const ui_node *node, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                          uint32_t scale, uint8_t *rgba, size_t stride,
                          uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
{
    uint32_t right = node->bounds.x + node->bounds.width;
    uint32_t bottom = node->bounds.y + node->bounds.height;
    uint32_t cursor = x;
    if (length > UI_TEXT_MAX_BYTES) length = UI_TEXT_MAX_BYTES;
    for (size_t index = 0U; index < length; ++index) {
        uint8_t character = (uint8_t)text[index];
        if (character >= 0x80U) {
            if ((character & 0xc0U) == 0x80U) continue;
            character = '?';
        }
        if (cursor > right || right - cursor < 5U) break;
        for (size_t row = 0U; row < 7U; ++row) {
            for (size_t column = 0U; column < 5U; ++column) {
                if ((ui_glyph_row(character, row) & (1U << (4U - column))) == 0U) continue;
                for (uint32_t sy = 0U; sy < scale; ++sy) {
                    for (uint32_t sx = 0U; sx < scale; ++sx) {
                        uint32_t px = cursor + (uint32_t)column * scale + sx;
                        uint32_t py = y + (uint32_t)row * scale + sy;
                        if (px < right && py < bottom && ui_pixel_valid(node, px, py, width, height))
                            ui_blend_pixel(rgba + (size_t)py * stride + (size_t)px * 4U, color);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        uint32_t advance = 6U * scale;
        if (cursor > UINT32_MAX - advance) break;
        cursor += advance;
    }
}

static bool ui_paint_node(const ui_tree *tree, const ui_node *node, uint8_t *rgba,
                          size_t stride, uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
                          bool draw_text)
{
    uint32_t fill = node->spec.color;
    if ((node->spec.state & UI_STATE_PRESSED) != 0U &&
        (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_BUTTON || node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_TEXT_FIELD ||
         node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_ROW)) fill = tree->tokens.selection_fill;
    else if ((node->spec.state & UI_STATE_HOVERED) != 0U &&
        (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_BUTTON || node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_TEXT_FIELD ||
         node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_ROW)) fill = tree->tokens.panel_raised;
    if ((fill & 255U) != 0U) {
        if (tree->semantic_style && (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_BUTTON ||
                node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_TEXT_FIELD))
            ui_paint_rounded_rect(node, fill, tree->tokens.radius, rgba, stride, width, height);
        else ui_paint_rect(node, fill, rgba, stride, width, height);
    }
    if (tree->semantic_style && (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_TEXT_FIELD ||
            (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_BUTTON &&
                node->spec.widget != UI_WIDGET_ICON_BUTTON)))
        ui_paint_control_outline(node, tree->tokens.control_edge,
            tree->tokens.radius, rgba, stride, width, height);
    if ((node->spec.state & UI_STATE_FOCUSED) != 0U &&
        node->spec.widget != UI_WIDGET_TREE_ROW &&
        node->bounds.width > 1U && node->bounds.height > 1U) {
        ui_node edge = *node;
        edge.bounds.height = 1U;
        ui_paint_rect(&edge, tree->tokens.focus_ring, rgba, stride, width, height);
        edge.bounds.y = node->bounds.y + node->bounds.height - 1U;
        ui_paint_rect(&edge, tree->tokens.focus_ring, rgba, stride, width, height);
        edge.bounds = (ui_rect){node->bounds.x, node->bounds.y + 1U, 1U,
            node->bounds.height - 2U};
        ui_paint_rect(&edge, tree->tokens.focus_ring, rgba, stride, width, height);
        edge.bounds.x = node->bounds.x + node->bounds.width - 1U;
        ui_paint_rect(&edge, tree->tokens.focus_ring, rgba, stride, width, height);
    }
    uint32_t color = (node->spec.state & UI_STATE_INVALID) != 0U ?
        tree->tokens.error : (node->spec.state & UI_STATE_DISABLED) != 0U ?
        tree->tokens.text_secondary : tree->tokens.text_primary;
    uint32_t scale = tree->tokens.font_px / 13U;
    if (tree->tokens.font_px % 13U != 0U) scale++;
    if (scale == 0U) scale = 1U;
    if (scale > 16U) scale = 16U;
    if (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_ROW && (node->spec.state & UI_STATE_CHECKED) != 0U)
        color = tree->tokens.accent;
    if (node->spec.icon != UI_ICON_NONE) {
        if (!draw_text) return true;
        if ((node->spec.state & UI_STATE_CHECKED) != 0U) color = tree->tokens.accent;
        return ui_icon_paint_legacy_into(node->spec.icon, tree->theme,
            tree->backing_scale > 0.0 ? tree->backing_scale : 1.0,
            node->bounds, color, rgba, width, height, stride);
    }
    if (!draw_text) return true;
    uint32_t glyph_height = 7U * scale;
    uint32_t text_y = node->bounds.y + (node->bounds.height > glyph_height ?
        (node->bounds.height - glyph_height) / 2U : 0U);
    uint32_t inset = 8U * scale;
    uint32_t text_x = node->bounds.x + (node->bounds.width > inset ? inset : 0U);
    if (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_BUTTON && node->spec.label_len <= 40U) {
        uint32_t text_width = (uint32_t)node->spec.label_len * 6U * scale;
        if (text_width < node->bounds.width) text_x = node->bounds.x + (node->bounds.width - text_width) / 2U;
    }
    ui_paint_text(node->label, node->spec.label_len, color, node, text_x, text_y,
        scale, rgba, stride, width, height);
    if (node->spec.role == UI_ROLE_TEXT_FIELD && node->spec.value_len > 0U) {
        uint32_t value_x = node->bounds.x + node->bounds.width / 2U;
        ui_paint_text(node->value, node->spec.value_len, color, node, value_x, text_y,
            scale, rgba, stride, width, height);
    }
    return true;
}

static bool ui_tree_paint_internal(const ui_tree *tree, uint8_t *rgba,
                                   size_t capacity, size_t stride,
                                   bool draw_text)
{
    if (tree == NULL || rgba == NULL || !tree->laid_out || tree->count == 0U ||
        tree->count > UI_MAX_NODES) return false;
    uint32_t width = tree->nodes[0].bounds.width;
    uint32_t height = tree->nodes[0].bounds.height;
    if (width == 0U || height == 0U || width > RASTER_TILE_MAX_AXIS ||
        height > RASTER_TILE_MAX_AXIS || (size_t)width > SIZE_MAX / 4U) return false;
    size_t row_bytes = (size_t)width * 4U;
    if (stride < row_bytes || (size_t)height > SIZE_MAX / stride ||
        capacity < stride * (size_t)height) return false;
    for (size_t index = 0U; index < tree->count; ++index) {
        if (!tree->nodes[index].occupied) return false;
        if (!ui_paint_node(tree, &tree->nodes[index], rgba, stride, width, height,
                draw_text)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool ui_tree_paint_into(const ui_tree *tree, uint8_t *rgba, size_t capacity,
                        size_t stride)
{
    return ui_tree_paint_internal(tree, rgba, capacity, stride, true);
}

bool ui_tree_paint_backgrounds_into(const ui_tree *tree, uint8_t *rgba,
                                    size_t capacity, size_t stride)
{
    return ui_tree_paint_internal(tree, rgba, capacity, stride, false);
}

bool ui_scalar_text_draw(const char *text, size_t length, ui_rect clip,
    uint32_t font_size_px, uint32_t color, uint8_t *rgba,
    uint32_t width, uint32_t height, size_t stride)
{
    if ((length > 0U && text == NULL) || length > UI_TEXT_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES ||
        font_size_px == 0U || rgba == NULL || width == 0U || height == 0U ||
        (size_t)width > SIZE_MAX / 4U || stride < (size_t)width * 4U ||
        (size_t)height > SIZE_MAX / stride || clip.x > width || clip.y > height ||
        clip.width > width - clip.x || clip.height > height - clip.y) return false;
    uint32_t scale = font_size_px / 13U + (font_size_px % 13U != 0U ? 1U : 0U);
    if (scale == 0U) scale = 1U;
    if (scale > 16U) scale = 16U;
    uint32_t glyph_height = 7U * scale;
    uint32_t y_origin = clip.y + (clip.height > glyph_height ?
        (clip.height - glyph_height) / 2U : 0U);
    uint32_t cursor = clip.x;
    uint32_t right = clip.x + clip.width;
    uint32_t bottom = clip.y + clip.height;
    for (size_t index = 0U; index < length; ++index) {
        uint8_t character = (uint8_t)text[index];
        if (character >= 0x80U) {
            if ((character & 0xc0U) == 0x80U) continue;
            character = '?';
        }
        if (cursor > right || right - cursor < 5U * scale) break;
        for (size_t row = 0U; row < 7U; ++row) {
            for (size_t column = 0U; column < 5U; ++column) {
                if ((ui_glyph_row(character, row) & (1U << (4U - column))) == 0U) continue;

    }
    if (*out_count == 0U) return false;
    for (size_t index = 0U; index < *out_count; ++index) {
        if (!valid_point(segments[index].x0, segments[index].y0) ||
            !valid_point(segments[index].x1, segments[index].y1)) return false;
        bounds_include(out_bounds, segments[index].x0, segments[index].y0);
        bounds_include(out_bounds, segments[index].x1, segments[index].y1);
    }
    return out_bounds->left <= out_bounds->right && out_bounds->top <= out_bounds->bottom;
}

size_t ui_icon_path_count(void)
{
    size_t count = 0U;
    (void)ui_icon_definitions(&count);
    return count;
}

bool ui_icon_path_at(size_t index, const char **out_name, const char **out_path,
                     size_t *out_path_length)
{
    if (out_name == NULL || out_path == NULL || out_path_length == NULL) return false;
    size_t count = 0U;
    const ui_icon_definition *items = ui_icon_definitions(&count);
    if (index >= count) return false;
    *out_name = items[index].name;
    *out_path = items[index].path;
    *out_path_length = items[index].path_length;
    return true;
}

bool ui_icon_path_validate(const char *path, size_t path_length,
                           ui_icon_bounds *out_bounds)
{
    ui_icon_segment segments[UI_ICON_MAX_SEGMENTS];
    size_t segment_count = 0U;
    ui_icon_bounds bounds = {0};
    if (!path_parse(path, path_length, segments, &segment_count, &bounds)) return false;
    if (out_bounds != NULL) *out_bounds = bounds;
    return true;
}

bool ui_icon_validate_all(void)
{
    size_t count = 0U;
    const ui_icon_definition *items = ui_icon_definitions(&count);
    if (count != (size_t)UI_ICON_COUNT - 1U) return false;
    for (size_t index = 0U; index < count; ++index) {
        if ((uint32_t)items[index].icon != index + 1U || items[index].name == NULL ||
            items[index].path == NULL || !ui_icon_path_validate(items[index].path,
                items[index].path_length, NULL)) return false;
        for (size_t prior = 0U; prior < index; ++prior) {
            if (items[prior].icon == items[index].icon ||
                strcmp(items[prior].name, items[index].name) == 0) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static double distance_squared(double px, double py, const ui_icon_segment *segment)
{
    double dx = segment->x1 - segment->x0, dy = segment->y1 - segment->y0;
    double length_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    double t = length_squared == 0.0 ? 0.0 :
        ((px - segment->x0) * dx + (py - segment->y0) * dy) / length_squared;
    if (t < 0.0) t = 0.0;
    if (t > 1.0) t = 1.0;
    double offset_x = px - (segment->x0 + t * dx);
    double offset_y = py - (segment->y0 + t * dy);
    return offset_x * offset_x + offset_y * offset_y;
}

static bool build_icon_mask(ui_icon_kind icon, uint32_t scale,
                            uint8_t **out_mask, uint32_t *out_axis)
{
    if (icon <= UI_ICON_NONE || icon >= UI_ICON_COUNT || scale == 0U ||
        scale > UI_ICON_MAX_SCALE || out_mask == NULL || out_axis == NULL) return false;
    uint32_t index = (uint32_t)icon - 1U;
    if (!icon_mask_ready[index][scale]) {
        const ui_icon_definition *definitions = ui_icon_definitions(NULL);
        ui_icon_segment segments[UI_ICON_MAX_SEGMENTS];
        size_t segment_count = 0U;
        ui_icon_bounds parsed_bounds = {0};
        const ui_icon_definition *definition = &definitions[index];
        if (!path_parse(definition->path, definition->path_length, segments,
                &segment_count, &parsed_bounds)) return false;
        uint8_t *mask = icon_masks[index][scale];
        memset(mask, 0, UI_ICON_MASK_BYTES);
        uint32_t axis = UI_ICON_VIEWBOX * scale;
        const double radius_squared = 0.75 * 0.75;
        for (uint32_t py = 0U; py < axis; ++py) {
            for (uint32_t px = 0U; px < axis; ++px) {
                unsigned covered = 0U;
                for (unsigned sy = 0U; sy < UI_ICON_AA_SAMPLES; ++sy) {
                    for (unsigned sx = 0U; sx < UI_ICON_AA_SAMPLES; ++sx) {
                        double x = ((double)px + ((double)sx + 0.5) /
                            (double)UI_ICON_AA_SAMPLES) / (double)scale;
                        double y = ((double)py + ((double)sy + 0.5) /
                            (double)UI_ICON_AA_SAMPLES) / (double)scale;
                        for (size_t segment = 0U; segment < segment_count; ++segment) {
                            double min_x = fmin(segments[segment].x0, segments[segment].x1) - 0.8;
                            double max_x = fmax(segments[segment].x0, segments[segment].x1) + 0.8;
                            double min_y = fmin(segments[segment].y0, segments[segment].y1) - 0.8;
                            double max_y = fmax(segments[segment].y0, segments[segment].y1) + 0.8;
                            if (x < min_x || x > max_x || y < min_y || y > max_y) continue;
                            if (distance_squared(x, y, &segments[segment]) <= radius_squared) {
                                covered++;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                mask[(size_t)py * axis + px] = (uint8_t)((covered * 255U + 8U) / 16U);
            }
        }
        icon_mask_ready[index][scale] = true;
    }
    *out_axis = UI_ICON_VIEWBOX * scale;
    *out_mask = icon_masks[index][scale];
    return true;
}

static void blend_mask_pixel(uint8_t *destination, uint32_t color, uint8_t coverage)
{
    uint32_t alpha = ((color & 255U) * coverage + 127U) / 255U;
    uint32_t inverse = 255U - alpha;
    uint32_t destination_alpha = destination[3];
    uint32_t out_alpha = alpha + (destination_alpha * inverse + 127U) / 255U;
    if (out_alpha == 0U) return;
    for (size_t channel = 0U; channel < 3U; ++channel) {
        uint32_t source = (color >> (24U - (uint32_t)(channel * 8U))) & 255U;
        uint32_t numerator = source * alpha * 255U +
            (uint32_t)destination[channel] * destination_alpha * inverse;
        destination[channel] = (uint8_t)((numerator + out_alpha * 127U) /
            (out_alpha * 255U));
    }
    destination[3] = (uint8_t)out_alpha;
}

static bool icon_paint_cached(ui_icon_kind icon, ui_theme theme, uint32_t scale,
    ui_rect bounds, uint32_t color, uint8_t *rgba, uint32_t width,
    uint32_t height, size_t stride)
{
    if (icon == UI_ICON_NONE) return true;
    if (theme < UI_THEME_DARK || theme > UI_THEME_LIGHT || rgba == NULL ||
        width == 0U || height == 0U ||
        (size_t)width > SIZE_MAX / 4U || stride < (size_t)width * 4U ||
        (size_t)height > SIZE_MAX / stride) return false;
    uint8_t *mask = NULL;
    uint32_t icon_axis = 0U;
    if (!build_icon_mask(icon, scale, &mask, &icon_axis)) return false;
    uint64_t origin_x64 = (uint64_t)bounds.x +
        (bounds.width > icon_axis ? (bounds.width - icon_axis) / 2U : 0U);
    uint64_t origin_y64 = (uint64_t)bounds.y +
        (bounds.height > icon_axis ? (bounds.height - icon_axis) / 2U : 0U);
    if (origin_x64 > UINT32_MAX || origin_y64 > UINT32_MAX) return false;
    uint32_t origin_x = (uint32_t)origin_x64, origin_y = (uint32_t)origin_y64;
    uint32_t draw_width = bounds.width < icon_axis ? bounds.width : icon_axis;
    uint32_t draw_height = bounds.height < icon_axis ? bounds.height : icon_axis;
    if (origin_x > width || draw_width > width - origin_x ||
        origin_y > height || draw_height > height - origin_y) return false;
    for (uint32_t y = 0U; y < draw_height; ++y) {
        for (uint32_t x = 0U; x < draw_width; ++x) {
            uint8_t coverage = mask[(size_t)y * icon_axis + x];
            if (coverage != 0U) blend_mask_pixel(rgba +
                (size_t)(origin_y + y) * stride + (size_t)(origin_x + x) * 4U,
                color, coverage);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool ui_icon_paint_into(ui_icon_kind icon, ui_theme theme, double backing_scale,
                        ui_rect bounds, uint32_t color, uint8_t *rgba,
                        uint32_t width, uint32_t height, size_t stride)
{
    if (!isfinite(backing_scale) || backing_scale < 0.5 ||
        backing_scale > (double)UI_ICON_MAX_SCALE) return false;
    uint32_t scale = (uint32_t)ceil(backing_scale);
    return icon_paint_cached(icon, theme, scale, bounds, color, rgba,
        width, height, stride);
}

static uint32_t state_color(const ui_tokens *tokens, ui_control_state state)
{
    switch (state) {
        case UI_CONTROL_DISABLED: return tokens->disabled_text;
        case UI_CONTROL_PRESSED:
        case UI_CONTROL_SELECTED: return tokens->accent;
        case UI_CONTROL_FOCUS: return tokens->focus_ring;
        case UI_CONTROL_INVALID: return tokens->error;
        case UI_CONTROL_REST:
        case UI_CONTROL_HOVER: default: return tokens->text_primary;
    }
}

static uint32_t style_cache_color(ui_icon_kind icon, ui_theme theme, bool increased,
    uint32_t scale, ui_control_state state, uint32_t color)
{
    size_t slot = 0U;
    for (size_t index = 0U; index < UI_ICON_STYLE_CACHE_COUNT; ++index) {
        ui_icon_style_entry *entry = &icon_style_cache[index];
        if (entry->valid && entry->icon == icon && entry->theme == theme &&
            entry->increased_contrast == increased && entry->scale == scale &&
            entry->state == state && entry->color == color) {
            entry->use = ++icon_style_clock;
            return entry->color;
        }
        if (entry->valid && entry->icon == icon && entry->theme == theme &&
            entry->increased_contrast == increased && entry->scale == scale &&
            entry->state == state) {
            entry->color = color;
            entry->use = ++icon_style_clock;
            return entry->color;
        }
        if (!entry->valid) { slot = index; goto selected; }
        if (entry->use < icon_style_cache[slot].use) slot = index;
    }
selected:
    icon_style_cache[slot] = (ui_icon_style_entry){.icon = icon, .theme = theme,
        .increased_contrast = increased, .scale = (uint8_t)scale,
        .state = state, .color = color, .use = ++icon_style_clock, .valid = true};
    return color;
}

bool ui_icon_paint_state_into(ui_icon_kind icon, ui_theme theme,
    bool increased_contrast, double backing_scale, ui_rect bounds,
    ui_control_state state, const ui_tokens *tokens, uint8_t *rgba,
    uint32_t width, uint32_t height, size_t stride)
{
    if (tokens == NULL || state < UI_CONTROL_REST || state > UI_CONTROL_INVALID ||
        theme < UI_THEME_DARK || theme > UI_THEME_LIGHT ||
        !isfinite(backing_scale) || backing_scale < 0.5 ||
        backing_scale > (double)UI_ICON_MAX_SCALE) return false;
    uint32_t scale = (uint32_t)ceil(backing_scale);
    uint32_t color = style_cache_color(icon, theme, increased_contrast, scale,
        state, state_color(tokens, state));
    return icon_paint_cached(icon, theme, scale, bounds, color, rgba,
        width, height, stride);
}

uint64_t ui_icon_asset_hash(ui_theme theme, uint32_t integer_scale)
{
    if (theme < UI_THEME_DARK || theme > UI_THEME_LIGHT || integer_scale == 0U ||
        integer_scale > UI_ICON_MAX_SCALE) return 0U;
    uint64_t hash = UINT64_C(1469598103934665603);
    for (uint32_t icon = UI_ICON_SELECT; icon < UI_ICON_COUNT; ++icon) {
        uint8_t *mask = NULL;
        uint32_t axis = 0U;
        if (!build_icon_mask((ui_icon_kind)icon, integer_scale, &mask, &axis)) return 0U;
        size_t length = (size_t)axis * axis;
        for (size_t index = 0U; index < length; ++index) {
            hash ^= mask[index];
            hash *= UINT64_C(1099511628211);
        }
    }
    return hash;
}

{
    memset(icon_mask_ready, 0, sizeof(icon_mask_ready));
    memset(icon_style_cache, 0, sizeof(icon_style_cache));
    icon_style_clock = 0U;
}

static uint8_t masks[2][LEGACY_MAX_SCALE + 1U][3U][LEGACY_MASK_BYTES];
static bool ready[2][LEGACY_MAX_SCALE + 1U][3U];

static void set_pixel(uint8_t *mask, uint32_t axis, int32_t x, int32_t y,
                      uint32_t stroke)
{
    int32_t radius = (int32_t)(stroke / 2U);
    for (int32_t dy = -radius; dy <= radius; ++dy) {
        for (int32_t dx = -radius; dx <= radius; ++dx) {
            int32_t px = x + dx, py = y + dy;
            if (px >= 0 && py >= 0 && (uint32_t)px < axis && (uint32_t)py < axis)
                mask[(size_t)(uint32_t)py * axis + (uint32_t)px] = 255U;
        }
    }
}

static void draw_segment(uint8_t *mask, uint32_t axis, legacy_segment segment,
                         uint32_t scale)
{
    int32_t x0 = (int32_t)segment.x1 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t y0 = (int32_t)segment.y1 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t x1 = (int32_t)segment.x2 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t y1 = (int32_t)segment.y2 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t dx = x1 >= x0 ? x1 - x0 : x0 - x1;
    int32_t sx = x0 < x1 ? 1 : -1;
    int32_t dy = y1 >= y0 ? y0 - y1 : y1 - y0;
    int32_t sy = y0 < y1 ? 1 : -1;
    int32_t error = dx + dy;
    for (;;) {
        set_pixel(mask, axis, x0, y0, (uint32_t)ceil(1.6 * (double)scale));
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) break;
        int32_t twice = 2 * error;
        if (twice >= dy) { error += dy; x0 += sx; }
        if (twice <= dx) { error += dx; y0 += sy; }
    }
}

static const legacy_segment *geometry(ui_icon_kind icon, size_t *out_count)
{
    if (icon == UI_ICON_SELECT) {
        *out_count = sizeof(select_geometry) / sizeof(select_geometry[0]);
        return select_geometry;
    }
    if (icon == UI_ICON_PAN) {
        *out_count = sizeof(pan_geometry) / sizeof(pan_geometry[0]);
        return pan_geometry;
    }
    if (icon == UI_ICON_ZOOM_IN) {
        *out_count = sizeof(zoom_geometry) / sizeof(zoom_geometry[0]);
        return zoom_geometry;
    }
    *out_count = 0U;
    return NULL;
}

static void blend(uint8_t *destination, uint32_t color)
{
    uint32_t alpha = color & 255U, inverse = 255U - alpha;
    uint32_t destination_alpha = destination[3];
    uint32_t out_alpha = alpha + (destination_alpha * inverse + 127U) / 255U;
    if (out_alpha == 0U) return;
    for (size_t channel = 0U; channel < 3U; ++channel) {
        uint32_t source = (color >> (24U - (uint32_t)(channel * 8U))) & 255U;
        uint32_t value = source * alpha * 255U +
            (uint32_t)destination[channel] * destination_alpha * inverse;
        destination[channel] = (uint8_t)((value + out_alpha * 127U) /
            (out_alpha * 255U));
    }
    destination[3] = (uint8_t)out_alpha;
}

bool ui_icon_paint_legacy_into(ui_icon_kind icon, ui_theme theme,
    double backing_scale, ui_rect bounds, uint32_t color, uint8_t *rgba,
    uint32_t width, uint32_t height, size_t stride)
{
    size_t segment_count = 0U;
    const legacy_segment *segments = geometry(icon, &segment_count);
    if (icon == UI_ICON_NONE) return true;
    if (segments == NULL || theme > UI_THEME_LIGHT || rgba == NULL ||
        !isfinite(backing_scale) || backing_scale < 0.5 ||
        backing_scale > (double)LEGACY_MAX_SCALE || width == 0U || height == 0U ||
        (size_t)width > SIZE_MAX / 4U || stride < (size_t)width * 4U ||
        (size_t)height > SIZE_MAX / stride) return false;
    uint32_t scale = (uint32_t)ceil(backing_scale);
    uint32_t theme_index = (uint32_t)theme;
    uint32_t icon_index = (uint32_t)icon - 1U;
    uint32_t axis = 24U * scale;
    if (!ready[theme_index][scale][icon_index]) {
        uint8_t *mask = masks[theme_index][scale][icon_index];
        memset(mask, 0, LEGACY_MASK_BYTES);
        for (size_t index = 0U; index < segment_count; ++index)
            draw_segment(mask, axis, segments[index], scale);
        ready[theme_index][scale][icon_index] = true;
    }
    uint64_t origin_x64 = (uint64_t)bounds.x +
        (bounds.width > axis ? (bounds.width - axis) / 2U : 0U);
    uint64_t origin_y64 = (uint64_t)bounds.y +
        (bounds.height > axis ? (bounds.height - axis) / 2U : 0U);
    if (origin_x64 > UINT32_MAX || origin_y64 > UINT32_MAX) return false;
    uint32_t origin_x = (uint32_t)origin_x64, origin_y = (uint32_t)origin_y64;
    uint32_t draw_width = bounds.width < axis ? bounds.width : axis;
    uint32_t draw_height = bounds.height < axis ? bounds.height : axis;
    if (origin_x > width || draw_width > width - origin_x ||
        origin_y > height || draw_height > height - origin_y) return false;
    const uint8_t *mask = masks[theme_index][scale][icon_index];
    for (uint32_t y = 0U; y < draw_height; ++y) {
        for (uint32_t x = 0U; x < draw_width; ++x) {
            if (mask[(size_t)y * axis + x] != 0U)
                blend(rgba + (size_t)(origin_y + y) * stride +
                    (size_t)(origin_x + x) * 4U, color);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static double linear_channel(uint32_t color, uint32_t shift)
{
    double value = (double)((color >> shift) & 255U) / 255.0;
    return value <= 0.04045 ? value / 12.92 : pow((value + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
}

static double luminance(uint32_t color)
{
    return 0.2126 * linear_channel(color, 24U) +
        0.7152 * linear_channel(color, 16U) +
        0.0722 * linear_channel(color, 8U);
}

static double contrast(uint32_t first, uint32_t second)
{
    double a = luminance(first), b = luminance(second);
    return (fmax(a, b) + 0.05) / (fmin(a, b) + 0.05);
}

static uint32_t color(uint8_t red, uint8_t green, uint8_t blue)
{
    return ((uint32_t)red << 24U) | ((uint32_t)green << 16U) |
        ((uint32_t)blue << 8U) | 255U;
}

static void print_contrast_values(const char *name, uint32_t foreground,
    const uint32_t *surfaces, const char *const *surface_names, size_t count)
{
    (void)printf("\"%s\":{", name);
    for (size_t index = 0U; index < count; ++index) {
        if (index > 0U) (void)putchar(',');
        (void)printf("\"%s\":%.3f", surface_names[index],
            contrast(foreground, surfaces[index]));
    }
    (void)putchar('}');
}

static void print_contrast_profile(const char *theme_name, ui_theme theme,
    bool increased_contrast)
{
    static const char *const surface_names[] = {
        "panel", "panel_raised", "panel_hover", "selection_fill", "canvas_well"
    };
    ui_tokens tokens = ui_theme_tokens(theme, increased_contrast);
    uint32_t text_surfaces[] = {tokens.panel, tokens.panel_raised, tokens.panel_hover,
        tokens.selection_fill, tokens.canvas_well};
    (void)printf("{\"theme\":\"%s\",\"increased_contrast\":%s,\"text\":{",
        theme_name, increased_contrast ? "true" : "false");
    print_contrast_values("primary", tokens.text_primary, text_surfaces,
        surface_names, sizeof(surface_names) / sizeof(surface_names[0]));
    (void)putchar(',');
    print_contrast_values("secondary", tokens.text_secondary, text_surfaces,
        surface_names, sizeof(surface_names) / sizeof(surface_names[0]));
    (void)printf("},\"controls\":{\"edge_panel\":%.3f,\"edge_panel_raised\":%.3f,"
        "\"edge_panel_hover\":%.3f,\"selection_edge_fill\":%.3f,"
        "\"focus_ring_panel\":%.3f},\"semantic\":{\"success_panel\":%.3f,"
        "\"warning_panel\":%.3f,\"error_panel\":%.3f}}",
        contrast(tokens.control_edge, tokens.panel),
        contrast(tokens.control_edge, tokens.panel_raised),
        contrast(tokens.control_edge, tokens.panel_hover),
        contrast(tokens.selection_edge, tokens.selection_fill),
        contrast(tokens.focus_ring, tokens.panel), contrast(tokens.success, tokens.panel),
        contrast(tokens.warning, tokens.panel), contrast(tokens.error, tokens.panel));
}

static int print_contrast_report(void)
{
    (void)printf("{\"version\":1,\"method\":\"WCAG 2.1 relative luminance, sRGB\","
        "\"minimums\":{\"text\":4.5,\"controls\":3.0},\"profiles\":[");

}

static double linear_channel(uint32_t color, uint32_t shift)
{
    double channel = (double)((color >> shift) & 255U) / 255.0;
    return channel <= 0.04045 ? channel / 12.92 :
        pow((channel + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
}

static double luminance(uint32_t color)
{
    return 0.2126 * linear_channel(color, 24U) +
        0.7152 * linear_channel(color, 16U) +
        0.0722 * linear_channel(color, 8U);
}

static double contrast(uint32_t first, uint32_t second)
{
    double a = luminance(first), b = luminance(second);
    double lighter = a > b ? a : b;
    double darker = a > b ? b : a;
    return (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05);
}

static uint32_t color(uint8_t red, uint8_t green, uint8_t blue)
{
    return ((uint32_t)red << 24U) | ((uint32_t)green << 16U) |
        ((uint32_t)blue << 8U) | 255U;
}

//! Bounded RGBA tile storage. Rendering and tile caching are separate ports.

/// Largest accepted width or height, matching `RASTER_TILE_MAX_AXIS`.
pub const MAX_AXIS: u32 = 4096;

/// Failure while validating or allocating tile storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TileError {
    /// Either dimension is zero or exceeds [`MAX_AXIS`].
    InvalidDimensions,
    /// The RGBA byte count cannot be represented by `usize`.
    SizeOverflow,
    /// The allocation could not be reserved.
    OutOfMemory,
}

/// An owned row-major RGBA tile.
///
/// Dropping the value releases its bytes. The mutable slice permits callers to
/// edit pixels without exposing or transferring the allocation itself.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Tile {
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    rgba: Vec<u8>,
}

impl Tile {
    /// Allocate a bounded deterministic opaque RGBA test tile.
    pub fn new(width: u32, height: u32) -> Result<Self, TileError> {
        if width == 0 || height == 0 || width > MAX_AXIS || height > MAX_AXIS {
            return Err(TileError::InvalidDimensions);
        }

        let bytes = usize::try_from(width)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|w| usize::try_from(height).ok().and_then(|h| w.checked_mul(h)))
            .and_then(|pixels| pixels.checked_mul(4))
            .ok_or(TileError::SizeOverflow)?;

        let mut rgba = Vec::new();
        rgba.try_reserve_exact(bytes).map_err(|_| TileError::OutOfMemory)?;
        rgba.resize(bytes, 0);

        for y in 0..height {
            for x in 0..width {
                let offset = ((y as usize) * (width as usize) + (x as usize)) * 4;
                rgba[offset] = ((x * 17 + y * 3) & 0xff) as u8;
                rgba[offset + 1] = ((x * 5 + y * 29) & 0xff) as u8;
                rgba[offset + 2] = ((x * 11 + y * 7) & 0xff) as u8;
                rgba[offset + 3] = 255;
            }
        }

        Ok(Self { width, height, rgba })
    }

    /// Tile width in pixels.
    pub const fn width(&self) -> u32 { self.width }

    /// Tile height in pixels.
    pub const fn height(&self) -> u32 { self.height }

    /// Number of bytes in the tightly packed RGBA storage.
    pub const fn byte_count(&self) -> usize { self.rgba.len() }

    /// Borrow all pixels as an immutable row-major RGBA byte slice.
    pub fn rgba(&self) -> &[u8] { &self.rgba }

    /// Borrow all pixels as a mutable row-major RGBA byte slice.
    pub fn rgba_mut(&mut self) -> &mut [u8] { &mut self.rgba }
}

static double distance_squared(double px, double py, const ui_icon_segment *segment)
{
    double dx = segment->x1 - segment->x0, dy = segment->y1 - segment->y0;
    double length_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    double t = length_squared == 0.0 ? 0.0 :
        ((px - segment->x0) * dx + (py - segment->y0) * dy) / length_squared;
    if (t < 0.0) t = 0.0;
    if (t > 1.0) t = 1.0;
    double offset_x = px - (segment->x0 + t * dx);
    double offset_y = py - (segment->y0 + t * dy);
    return offset_x * offset_x + offset_y * offset_y;
}

static void blend_mask_pixel(uint8_t *destination, uint32_t color, uint8_t coverage)
{

    uint32_t inverse = 255U - alpha;
    uint32_t destination_alpha = destination[3];
    uint32_t out_alpha = alpha + (destination_alpha * inverse + 127U) / 255U;
    if (out_alpha == 0U) return;
    for (size_t channel = 0U; channel < 3U; ++channel) {
        uint32_t source = (color >> (24U - (uint32_t)(channel * 8U))) & 255U;
        uint32_t numerator = source * alpha * 255U +
            (uint32_t)destination[channel] * destination_alpha * inverse;
        destination[channel] = (uint8_t)((numerator + out_alpha * 127U) /
            (out_alpha * 255U));
    }
    destination[3] = (uint8_t)out_alpha;
}

            entry->state == state && entry->color == color) {
            entry->use = ++icon_style_clock;
            return entry->color;
        }
        if (entry->valid && entry->icon == icon && entry->theme == theme &&
            entry->increased_contrast == increased && entry->scale == scale &&
            entry->state == state) {
            entry->color = color;
            entry->use = ++icon_style_clock;
            return entry->color;
        }
        if (!entry->valid) { slot = index; goto selected; }
        if (entry->use < icon_style_cache[slot].use) slot = index;
    }
selected:
    icon_style_cache[slot] = (ui_icon_style_entry){.icon = icon, .theme = theme,
        .increased_contrast = increased, .scale = (uint8_t)scale,
        .state = state, .color = color, .use = ++icon_style_clock, .valid = true};
    return color;
}

bool ui_icon_paint_state_into(ui_icon_kind icon, ui_theme theme,
    bool increased_contrast, double backing_scale, ui_rect bounds,
    ui_control_state state, const ui_tokens *tokens, uint8_t *rgba,
    uint32_t width, uint32_t height, size_t stride)
{
    if (tokens == NULL || state < UI_CONTROL_REST || state > UI_CONTROL_INVALID ||
        theme < UI_THEME_DARK || theme > UI_THEME_LIGHT ||
        !isfinite(backing_scale) || backing_scale < 0.5 ||
        backing_scale > (double)UI_ICON_MAX_SCALE) return false;
    uint32_t scale = (uint32_t)ceil(backing_scale);
    uint32_t color = style_cache_color(icon, theme, increased_contrast, scale,
        state, state_color(tokens, state));
    return icon_paint_cached(icon, theme, scale, bounds, color, rgba,
        width, height, stride);
}

uint64_t ui_icon_asset_hash(ui_theme theme, uint32_t integer_scale)
{
    if (theme < UI_THEME_DARK || theme > UI_THEME_LIGHT || integer_scale == 0U ||
        integer_scale > UI_ICON_MAX_SCALE) return 0U;
    uint64_t hash = UINT64_C(1469598103934665603);
    for (uint32_t icon = UI_ICON_SELECT; icon < UI_ICON_COUNT; ++icon) {
        uint8_t *mask = NULL;
        uint32_t axis = 0U;
        if (!build_icon_mask((ui_icon_kind)icon, integer_scale, &mask, &axis)) return 0U;
        size_t length = (size_t)axis * axis;
        for (size_t index = 0U; index < length; ++index) {
            hash ^= mask[index];
            hash *= UINT64_C(1099511628211);
        }
    }
    return hash;
}

static void set_pixel(uint8_t *mask, uint32_t axis, int32_t x, int32_t y,
                      uint32_t stroke)
{
    int32_t radius = (int32_t)(stroke / 2U);
    for (int32_t dy = -radius; dy <= radius; ++dy) {
        for (int32_t dx = -radius; dx <= radius; ++dx) {
            int32_t px = x + dx, py = y + dy;
            if (px >= 0 && py >= 0 && (uint32_t)px < axis && (uint32_t)py < axis)
                mask[(size_t)(uint32_t)py * axis + (uint32_t)px] = 255U;
        }
    }
}

static void draw_segment(uint8_t *mask, uint32_t axis, legacy_segment segment,
                         uint32_t scale)
{
    int32_t x0 = (int32_t)segment.x1 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t y0 = (int32_t)segment.y1 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t x1 = (int32_t)segment.x2 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t y1 = (int32_t)segment.y2 * (int32_t)scale;
    int32_t dx = x1 >= x0 ? x1 - x0 : x0 - x1;
    int32_t sx = x0 < x1 ? 1 : -1;
    int32_t dy = y1 >= y0 ? y0 - y1 : y1 - y0;
    int32_t sy = y0 < y1 ? 1 : -1;
    int32_t error = dx + dy;
    for (;;) {
        set_pixel(mask, axis, x0, y0, (uint32_t)ceil(1.6 * (double)scale));
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) break;
        int32_t twice = 2 * error;
        if (twice >= dy) { error += dy; x0 += sx; }
        if (twice <= dx) { error += dx; y0 += sy; }
    }
}

static const legacy_segment *geometry(ui_icon_kind icon, size_t *out_count)
{
    if (icon == UI_ICON_SELECT) {
        *out_count = sizeof(select_geometry) / sizeof(select_geometry[0]);
        return select_geometry;
    }
    if (icon == UI_ICON_PAN) {
        *out_count = sizeof(pan_geometry) / sizeof(pan_geometry[0]);
        return pan_geometry;
    }
    if (icon == UI_ICON_ZOOM_IN) {
        *out_count = sizeof(zoom_geometry) / sizeof(zoom_geometry[0]);
        return zoom_geometry;
    }
    *out_count = 0U;
    return NULL;
}

static void blend(uint8_t *destination, uint32_t color)
{
    uint32_t alpha = color & 255U, inverse = 255U - alpha;
    uint32_t destination_alpha = destination[3];
    uint32_t out_alpha = alpha + (destination_alpha * inverse + 127U) / 255U;
    if (out_alpha == 0U) return;
    for (size_t channel = 0U; channel < 3U; ++channel) {
        uint32_t source = (color >> (24U - (uint32_t)(channel * 8U))) & 255U;
        uint32_t value = source * alpha * 255U +
            (uint32_t)destination[channel] * destination_alpha * inverse;
        destination[channel] = (uint8_t)((value + out_alpha * 127U) /
            (out_alpha * 255U));
    }
    destination[3] = (uint8_t)out_alpha;
}

bool ui_icon_paint_legacy_into(ui_icon_kind icon, ui_theme theme,
    double backing_scale, ui_rect bounds, uint32_t color, uint8_t *rgba,
    uint32_t width, uint32_t height, size_t stride)
{
    size_t segment_count = 0U;
    const legacy_segment *segments = geometry(icon, &segment_count);
    if (icon == UI_ICON_NONE) return true;
    if (segments == NULL || theme > UI_THEME_LIGHT || rgba == NULL ||
        !isfinite(backing_scale) || backing_scale < 0.5 ||
        backing_scale > (double)LEGACY_MAX_SCALE || width == 0U || height == 0U ||
        (size_t)width > SIZE_MAX / 4U || stride < (size_t)width * 4U ||
        (size_t)height > SIZE_MAX / stride) return false;
    uint32_t scale = (uint32_t)ceil(backing_scale);
    uint32_t theme_index = (uint32_t)theme;
    uint32_t icon_index = (uint32_t)icon - 1U;
    uint32_t axis = 24U * scale;
    if (!ready[theme_index][scale][icon_index]) {
        uint8_t *mask = masks[theme_index][scale][icon_index];
        memset(mask, 0, LEGACY_MASK_BYTES);
        for (size_t index = 0U; index < segment_count; ++index)
            draw_segment(mask, axis, segments[index], scale);
        ready[theme_index][scale][icon_index] = true;
    }
    uint64_t origin_x64 = (uint64_t)bounds.x +
        (bounds.width > axis ? (bounds.width - axis) / 2U : 0U);
    uint64_t origin_y64 = (uint64_t)bounds.y +
        (bounds.height > axis ? (bounds.height - axis) / 2U : 0U);
    if (origin_x64 > UINT32_MAX || origin_y64 > UINT32_MAX) return false;
    uint32_t origin_x = (uint32_t)origin_x64, origin_y = (uint32_t)origin_y64;
    uint32_t draw_width = bounds.width < axis ? bounds.width : axis;
    uint32_t draw_height = bounds.height < axis ? bounds.height : axis;
    if (origin_x > width || draw_width > width - origin_x ||
        origin_y > height || draw_height > height - origin_y) return false;
    const uint8_t *mask = masks[theme_index][scale][icon_index];
    for (uint32_t y = 0U; y < draw_height; ++y) {
        for (uint32_t x = 0U; x < draw_width; ++x) {
            if (mask[(size_t)y * axis + x] != 0U)
                blend(rgba + (size_t)(origin_y + y) * stride +
                    (size_t)(origin_x + x) * 4U, color);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

impl Tree {

    pub fn accessible(theme:Theme,increased_contrast:bool)->Result<Self,TreeError>{

    }
    pub fn find(&self,id:u32)->Option<&Node>{self.nodes.iter().find(|n|n.spec.id==id)}
    pub fn find_mut(&mut self,id:u32)->Option<&mut Node>{self.nodes.iter_mut().find(|n|n.spec.id==id)}
    pub fn add(&mut self,mut spec:NodeSpec)->Result<(),TreeError>{
        let label_len=spec.label.len();let value_len=spec.value.len();
        if self.laid_out || self.nodes.len()>=MAX_NODES {return Err(TreeError::Capacity)}

        if let Some(p)=parent{self.nodes[p].children.try_reserve(1).map_err(|_|TreeError::Allocation)?;}
        self.nodes.try_reserve(1).map_err(|_|TreeError::Allocation)?;

    pub fn layout(&mut self,width:u32,height:u32)->Result<(),TreeError>{

    }
    pub fn render(&self)->Result<Tile,TreeError>{
        if !self.laid_out||self.nodes.is_empty(){return Err(TreeError::NotLaidOut)}

        for node in &self.nodes {if node.spec.color&255==0{continue} paint_rect(&mut tile,node.bounds,node.spec.color)?;
            if node.spec.state&STATE_FOCUSED!=0 {paint_ring(&mut tile,node.bounds,self.tokens.focus_ring)?;}}
        Ok(tile)
    }
    pub fn semantics(&self)->Result<SemanticsSnapshot,TreeError>{SemanticsSnapshot::from_tree(self)}
    pub fn focus_next(&mut self,reverse:bool)->bool{
        if self.nodes.len()<2{return false}let current=self.nodes.iter().position(|n|n.spec.id==self.focused_id);
        let start=current.unwrap_or(if reverse{self.nodes.len()-1}else{0});
        for step in 1..=self.nodes.len(){let i=if reverse{(start+self.nodes.len()-(step%self.nodes.len()))%self.nodes.len()}else{(start+step)%self.nodes.len()};
            if focusable(&self.nodes[i]){for n in &mut self.nodes{n.spec.state&=!STATE_FOCUSED}self.nodes[i].spec.state|=STATE_FOCUSED;self.focused_id=self.nodes[i].spec.id;return true}}
        false
    }
    pub fn dispatch_key(&mut self,registry:Option<&CommandRegistry>,key:u32,modifiers:u32)->Option<u32>{
        const TAB:u32=0x110000;const RETURN:u32=0x110001;const SPACE:u32=0x110002;const SHIFT:u32=1;
        if key==TAB{return self.focus_next(modifiers&SHIFT!=0).then_some(0)}
        if key==RETURN||key==SPACE {let i=self.nodes.iter().position(|n|n.spec.id==self.focused_id)?;if !focusable(&self.nodes[i]){return None}
            if self.nodes[i].spec.role==Role::Checkbox{self.nodes[i].spec.state^=STATE_CHECKED;return Some(self.nodes[i].spec.command_id)}
            return (self.nodes[i].spec.command_id!=0).then_some(self.nodes[i].spec.command_id)}
        registry.and_then(|r|r.lookup(key,modifiers))
    }
}

fn root_spec()->Result<NodeSpec,TreeError>{let mut label=String::new();label.try_reserve_exact(6).map_err(|_|TreeError::Allocation)?;label.push_str("Editor");let mut root=NodeSpec::new(ROOT_ID,0);root.axis=Axis::Vertical;root.role=Role::Window;root.label=label;Ok(root)}
fn preview(s:&str)->Result<String,TreeError>{let mut end=s.len().min(MAX_TEXT_BYTES-1);while !s.is_char_boundary(end){end-=1}let mut out=String::new();out.try_reserve_exact(end).map_err(|_|TreeError::Allocation)?;out.push_str(&s[..end]);Ok(out)}
fn focusable(n:&Node)->bool{matches!(n.spec.role,Role::Button|Role::Checkbox|Role::TextField|Role::Slider|Role::Row)&&n.spec.state&STATE_DISABLED==0}
fn layout_node(nodes:&[Node],i:usize,box_:Rect,depth:usize,out:&mut[Rect])->Result<(),TreeError>{

    let twice=n.spec.padding.checked_mul(2).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?;let x=box_.x.checked_add(n.spec.padding).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?;let y=box_.y.checked_add(n.spec.padding).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?;
    let iw=if box_.width>twice{box_.width-twice}else{0};let ih=if box_.height>twice{box_.height-twice}else{0};
    if n.spec.axis==Axis::Overlay {for &c in &n.children{let cn=&nodes[c];let w=if cn.spec.preferred_width==0{iw}else{cn.spec.preferred_width.min(iw)};let h=if cn.spec.preferred_height==0{ih}else{cn.spec.preferred_height.min(ih)};layout_node(nodes,c,Rect{x,y,width:w,height:h},depth+1,out)?}return Ok(())}
    let horizontal=n.spec.axis==Axis::Horizontal;let main=if horizontal{iw}else{ih};let cross=if horizontal{ih}else{iw};
    let gaps=n.spec.gap.checked_mul((n.children.len()-1) as u32).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?;let mut fixed=0u32;let mut flexible=0u32;
    for &c in &n.children{let wanted=if horizontal{nodes[c].spec.preferred_width}else{nodes[c].spec.preferred_height};if wanted==0{flexible+=1}else{fixed=fixed.checked_add(wanted).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?}}
    let available=main-main.min(gaps);let mut flex_extent=available.saturating_sub(fixed);let mut remaining=main;let mut cursor=if horizontal{x}else{y};
    for (pos,&c) in n.children.iter().enumerate(){if pos>0&&remaining>0{let gap=n.spec.gap.min(remaining);cursor=cursor.checked_add(gap).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?;remaining-=gap}
        let cn=&nodes[c];let preferred=if horizontal{cn.spec.preferred_width}else{cn.spec.preferred_height};let mut extent=if preferred==0{if flexible==0{0}else{flex_extent/flexible}}else{preferred};extent=extent.min(remaining);
        if preferred==0&&flexible>0{flex_extent=flex_extent.saturating_sub(extent);flexible-=1}
        let cp=if horizontal{cn.spec.preferred_height}else{cn.spec.preferred_width};let cextent=if cp==0||cp>cross{cross}else{cp};let child_box=if horizontal{Rect{x:cursor,y,width:extent,height:cextent}}else{Rect{x,y:cursor,width:cextent,height:extent}};
        layout_node(nodes,c,child_box,depth+1,out)?;cursor=cursor.checked_add(extent).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?;remaining-=extent;

}
fn paint_rect(tile:&mut Tile,r:Rect,color:u32)->Result<(),TreeError>{if color&255==0{return Ok(())}let width=tile.width();let x2=r.x.checked_add(r.width).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?.min(width);let y2=r.y.checked_add(r.height).ok_or(TreeError::Layout)?.min(tile.height());let src=[(color>>24)as u8,(color>>16)as u8,(color>>8)as u8];

fn linear(c: u32, shift: u32) -> f64 { let v = ((c >> shift) & 255) as f64 / 255.0; if v <= 0.04045 { v / 12.92 } else { ((v + 0.055) / 1.055).powf(2.4) } }
fn luminance(c: u32) -> f64 { 0.2126*linear(c,24) + 0.7152*linear(c,16) + 0.0722*linear(c,8) }
fn contrast(a: u32,b: u32) -> f64 { let (x,y)=(luminance(a),luminance(b)); (x.max(y)+0.05)/(x.min(y)+0.05) }
fn accent_candidate(source: u32, lighten: bool, percent: u32) -> u32 {
    let mut out=0; for shift in [8,16,24] { let channel=(source>>shift)&255; let target=if lighten {255} else {0}; let adjusted=(channel*(100-percent)+target*percent+50)/100; out|=adjusted<<shift; } out|255
}

    let mut row=NodeSpec::new(6,ROOT_ID);row.role=Role::Row;t.add(row).unwrap();

    assert!(t.focus_next(false));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,2);
    for expected in [4,5,6,7,2]{assert!(t.focus_next(false));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,expected,"forward traversal skipped or reordered focusable roles")}
    assert!(t.focus_next(true));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,7);assert!(t.focus_next(true));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,6);
    assert!(t.focus_next(false));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,7);assert_eq!(t.dispatch_key(None,0x110001,0),Some(12));assert_eq!(t.find(7).unwrap().spec.state&2,2);
    for expected in [2,4,5,6,7]{assert!(t.focus_next(false));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,expected,"forward wrap across row/checkbox/button roles")}
    assert!(t.focus_next(false));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,2);assert!(t.focus_next(true));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,7);
    assert!(t.focus_next(false));assert_eq!(t.focused_id,2);assert_eq!(t.dispatch_key(None,0x110002,0),Some(11));
    let mut r=CommandRegistry::new();r.register(20,'s' as u32,2,true).unwrap();assert_eq!(r.register(20,'x' as u32,0,true),Err(TreeError::DuplicateId));
    assert_eq!(r.register(21,'s' as u32,2,true),Err(TreeError::DuplicateId));assert_eq!(r.register(22,'q' as u32,0x8000_0000,true),Err(TreeError::InvalidInput));
    assert_eq!(t.dispatch_key(Some(&r),'s' as u32,2),Some(20));assert_eq!(t.dispatch_key(Some(&r),'s' as u32,0),None);

}
